title: P1 complete: request
description: The holder hands in the outcome: the attempt result by the type's schema (result), a delivery receipt or the outcome of a monitor_script delivery (receipt), a tool call result (output), the outcome of erasure or match work (erasure). In the same transaction the core writes the transition, event, deliveries and usage (DLV-2). The request has neither addresses nor record fields (DLV-6, IDN-1). The lease token is not passed in the body: the holder sends it in the Botaru-Lease header (spec/bindings/http/README.md), one way for all operations under a lease (FEN-2).

result.description: Attempt result; the core checks it with the full result_schema of the type, otherwise output_schema_invalid.

output.description: Plugin outcome for a tool call; for a write call the toolhost has checked the approval_id or grant_id, the tenant and the argument hash.
output.x-botaru-closed-by: result_schema of the tool from the catalog (builtin-tools.yaml or the plugin manifest)

receipt.description: Delivery receipt: the external message id; for a monitor_script delivery the exit code and the output truncated to 4096 bytes, which the core writes to the task journal as untrusted data (DLV-3).

location.description: Only the E2 sink: where the artifact is written; built from the manifest base, the tenant and the id (DLV-6).

erasure.description: Outcome of work of kind erasure: a step of an erasure or match request at an edge store (RET-4, RET-7).

monitor_note.description: From v0.2: a bot note on a monitoring problem next to result (MON-7). The core checks it; a refused note is dropped with its reason in the task journal and does not change the task outcome.

eventid.description: Id of the problem event in the monitoring system.

text.description: Note text; untrusted, redacted before delivery (INJ-4, INJ-11).
